name: Dog Wash Etiquette
texts: 1. LEASH IN THE TUB2. RINSE THE TUB3. WIPE YOUR STATION
caption:
A little dog wash etiquette goes a long way 🐾
Keep pups leashed in the tub, give the tub a rinse, and wipe down your station when you're done.
Thanks for keeping it fresh for the next pupstomer! ✨
